title: Demonic Path Secret Piece
next_chapter_hook: The Demonic Path Commander said before dissipating: "The fourth possibility lies within the resonance of your bloodline with hers."

text.content: The Liquidation Master's voice exploded like thunder across the capital's sky, his golden dharma form obscuring half the celestial dome, the pressure crushing down like tangible substance, stagnating the air for miles. Chen Ji stood atop the ruins, the turtle shell suspended above his head, its dim light barely resisting the judgment from the heavens. "Hand over the turtle shell, or perish with the Three Realms—" The Liquidation Master's voice carried absolute authority. "You, a designed key, dare resist the will of Heaven?" A cold smile subtly curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth.

dialogue.content: "A key? Designed by Heaven?" Chen Ji softly repeated these words, his voice terrifyingly calm. "Liquidation Master, how many years have you sat on Heaven's Eye's chessboard? Have you ever considered that your self-proclaimed chess player status is merely another piece in the eyes of those above?"

text.content: Before his words finished, a pitch-black spatial rift tore open above the capital. The气息 emanating from that rift was entirely opposite to the heavenly pressure—demonic energy,浓郁得几乎凝成实质的魔气. A figure emerged slowly from the rift, black robes billowing, dozens of demonic path law chains coiled around it, each radiating a terrifying pressure that could shift heaven and earth. The Demonic Path Commander had descended upon the capital.

dialogue.content: "The Holy Sect Commander has arrived!" Ye Qing's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying uncontrollable shock. "Why would he come personally? This was never in any prediction—Chen Ji, how many trump cards are you still hiding?" Chen Ji didn't answer, merely watching that figure slowly descend, but his heart stirred with a bitter sense of relief. The Demonic Path Commander had waited for this day far too long.

Chen Ji gazed at the descending figure, a flash of understanding flickering in his eyes. He had waited for this moment for far too long. Starting from Chapter 616 when the Demonic Path suddenly took interest in the Three Sects' dispute, he had been waiting for this variable to appear. "You've finally decided to show yourself," Chen Ji's voice was calm. "First Observer.

The Demonic Path Commander stepped forward slowly, demonic energy transforming into order chains that clashed against the Liquidation Master's golden dharma form. "This one has waited seven thousand three hundred years for this day." His voice was aged yet commanding, a jarring contrast with his youthful appearance. "Back then, this one used the dimensional origin as the price, sealing the remnant soul into the Demonic Holy Sect, merely to await a variable capable of breaking the seal." He turned to look at Chen Ji, a complex emotion in his eyes. "And you, are that variable."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart trembled, but his expression remained unchanged. He recalled that vague premonition in Chapter 616—the Demonic Path's interest in the Three Sects. At the time, everyone thought the Demonic Path wanted to profit from the chaos, but he had seen a deeper meaning. He was waiting for a variable. "So you weren't picking sides," Chen Ji spoke slowly. "You were completing a layout spanning seven thousand years." The Demonic Path Commander nodded slightly. Between them, a dust-laden memory fragment surfaced.

That was a scene from ancient times—the First Observer stood before the dimensional rift, behind him the original form of the Tianji Record. Before him was the massive projection of the Heavenly Eye, their dialogue crossing the river of time. "The Tianji Record is merely your projection in the lower dimension?" Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. The Demonic Path Commander shook his head: "No, the Tianji Record is this one's split-off resolve. The dimension is too high; it cannot directly affect the lower realms, so this one needed an eye, a pair of eyes that could walk in the lower realms."

dialogue.content: "So all the prophets throughout history were pieces you set in motion?" Chen Ji's voice turned cold. The Demonic Path Commander nodded frankly: "Correct. Including Chen Xuan, and including you. But you differ from them—" He paused. "You are the first person to show this one the fourth possibility." Chen Ji's heart leaped violently. The fourth possibility—that was an answer he had never deduced from the Tianji Record.

choice.prompt: Facing the remnant soul of the First Observer's reincarnation, Chen Ji must make a crucial choice—whether to accept this layout spanning seven thousand years, or remain vigilant and continue investigating the truth.

choices.description: "Since our goals align, temporarily set aside doubts and first use the Demonic Path Commander's power to break the current predicament."
choices.visible_cost: "Owe the Demonic Path Commander a favor"
choices.risk_hint: "May be devoured by a deeper chess game"

text.content: Chen Ji clasped his hands and said: "Since senior's goal aligns with this junior's, this assistance, this junior shall not decline." A flash of approval crossed the Demonic Path Commander's eyes, his demonic energy surging violently, resonating with Chen Ji's turtle shell. A pitch-black demonic law fused into the seal, and the precarious dimensional node began to stabilize.

choices.description: "Accept cooperation on the surface while secretly retaining trump cards, preventing reverse calculation."

text.content: Chen Ji slightly nodded but gave no definite answer: "Senior's layout impresses this junior. However, there is no free banquet in this world—this junior is very curious, what exactly is this 'fourth possibility' you speak of?" The Demonic Path Commander gazed into Chen Ji's eyes, then suddenly laughed: "Good, good, good! No wonder you are the one the Tianji Record chose."

choices.description: "Demand the Demonic Path Commander fully disclose the details of his seven-thousand-year layout, accepting no concealment."

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly sharpened: "Senior said this junior is the variable, then the variable should have the variable's觉悟. Seven thousand years of layout—what exactly do you want to break? The dimensional seal, or—" He paused. "The Heavenly Eye itself?" The Demonic Path Commander's smile froze on his face, and silence lasted three breaths.

After a moment of silence, the Demonic Path Commander suddenly burst into laughter, that laughter carrying seven thousand years of vicissitudes andrelieved. "Excellent! Excellent Chen Ji!" His form began to fade transparent, yet the demonic energy around him grew increasingly intense. "Since you asked, this one will tell you—the dimensional seal is merely the beginning. The true target is that Heavenly Will that treats all prophets as chess pieces!" His voice abruptly rose. "The Heavenly Eye!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. The Heavenly Eye—that terrifying consciousness he only became aware of in Volume 8, that transcending existence that used generations of prophets as pieces. "You mean to say—" His voice somewhat hoarse. "The Tianji Record itself was a piece it set?" The Demonic Path Commander shook his head: "No, the Tianji Record is this one's eye, but it has been contaminated by it. Starting from Chen Xuan's generation, the Heavenly Eye has been trying to reclaim this pair of eyes."

text.content: Chen Ji finally understood. The so-called Heavenly Fate consumption was fundamentally the Heavenly Eye recovering the Tianji Record's power. Every time one foresaw the future, it was输送 back to that transcending consciousness. "So what you want to break is its control over the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji's voice was low. The Demonic Path Commander nodded: "Not merely control. This one wants to completely sever its触手 reaching into the lower realms."

dialogue.content: "How to sever?" Chen Ji pressed. The Demonic Path Commander's form had already faded nearly transparent, his demonic energy transforming into order chains that coiled around Chen Ji's turtle shell. "Using this one's remnant dimensional origin as the price, reinforcing the dimensional node of the seal." His voice became ethereal. "At the same time, this one will transfer the entire intelligence network of the Demonic Holy Sect to you. From now on, the Demonic Path is your eye."

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander was about to dissipate, and Chen Ji needed to make a choice in the final moment—how to handle this legacy spanning seven thousand years.

choices.description: "Accept all gifts from the Demonic Path Commander—intelligence network, dimensional origin, and his unfulfilled will."

text.content: Chen Ji solemnly knelt on one knee: "Senior, rest assured, this will, Chen Ji accepts." The Demonic Path Commander's form completely dissipated, yet that dimensional origin flowed like a trickle into the turtle shell. Above the capital, the Liquidation Master's expression drastically changed—he clearly sensed that the waste he could have crushed at will, now had behind him a force sufficient to counter him.

choices.description: "Only accept the intelligence network, reject the karma brought by dimensional origin, maintain independence."

text.content: Chen Ji slightly shook his head: "Senior's will, this junior thanks for. But regarding karma, this junior still wishes to bear it alone." The Demonic Path Commander's form paused, then sighed lightly: "Very well. The intelligence network will be enough for your use." An arcane rune flew from his brow center into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. In an instant, countless Demonic Path secrets flooded his mind like a tide.

With the complete dissipation of the Demonic Path Commander, the capital's pattern above suddenly reversed. The turtle shell, empowered by the dimensional origin, burst forth unprecedented light, and the seal that had been dimmed by heavenly pressure began to stabilize anew. The Liquidation Master's expression became extremely unsightly—never in his wildest imagination did he expect a piece about to be crushed could turn the tables in the final moment. "You—" His voice trembled with disbelief.

Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a faint smile in his eyes. The secret piece laid since Chapter 616 had finally发挥作用. He recalled those Demonic Path movements he had deliberately ignored, those seemingly irrelevant Holy Sect intelligence—all along, this had been within the anticipation of this existence spanning seven thousand years. "Liquidation Master," Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "You just said I was a designed key?" A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth. "Have you ever considered that a key can also open a cage, releasing the caged bird back to the mountains and forests?"

As his words fell, the turtle shell erupted with a towering column of light that pierced through the Liquidation Master's golden dharma form, stabbing directly into the heavens. Across the capital battlefield, countless cultivators looked up, only to see that the once invincible Liquidation Master was shaken back tens of thousands of miles by this strike. The Demonic Holy Sect army let out a thunderous cheer, while the cultivators of the Three Great Sects looked at each other in bewilderment—they finally realized whose terrifying backing lay behind thattrash杂役弟子 deemed as trash.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, the countless pieces of information within the Demonic Path intelligence network circulating in his Mental Sea. He now knew—all intelligence the Demonic Holy Sect had gathered over seven thousand years about the Heavenly Eye, about the structure of the dimensional seal, about records of prophets throughout history... everything was now at his fingertips. But he also knew this was merely the beginning. "The fourth possibility," he quietly repeated the Demonic Path Commander's final words. "Bloodline resonance..." Chen Nian. His younger sister, that existence the Holy Sect had taken away as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

text.content: Ye Qing's figure silently appeared at Chen Ji's side, her eyes carrying complex emotions. "I never expected the Demonic Path Commander to be the reincarnation of the First Observer," her voice was somewhat hoarse. "Even less expected he would choose you as his successor." Chen Ji turned to look at her, the corner of his mouth lifting: "Surprised?" Ye Qingscoffed coldly一声: "I merely find it curious how many trump cards you still haven't revealed." Chen Ji gave no answer, merely transmitting a piece of information into her Mental Sea—that was the latest intelligence about the Heavenly Eye from the Demonic Path intelligence network.

dialogue.content: "Before dissipating, the Demonic Path Commander said the fourth possibility lies within the bloodline resonance between me and Chen Nian." Chen Ji's voice was low. "From now on, finding Chen Nian is my only goal." Ye Qing remained silent for a moment, then softly said: "The Holy Sect headquarters lies deep within the Heavenly Demon Domain, where the entrance to the Ancient Forbidden Land exists. To enter it, Demonic Path assistance is impossible." Chen Ji nodded: "So from now on, the Demonic Path is our ally."

text.content: The battle above the capital was nearing its end. After being shaken back by that strike, the Heavenly Liquidation Master seemed to be reassessing, temporarily not striking again. Chen Ji stood atop the ruins, behind him the just-subdued Demonic Path army, before him a gradually clearing war situation. Yet his heart held not a trace of ease—because he knew the Heavenly Eye would not take this lying down. From now on, he was no longer merely thattrash弟子 playing the tiger to eat the king, but a chess player standing in the open and playing against Heaven.
